content:
The image shows a mango leaf with multiple discrete, dark brown-to-black necrotic lesions scattered across the leaf surface. The lesions are roughly circular/irregular, with defined margins, and some appear to have caused tissue collapse or shot-hole appearance. The rest of the leaf is green and healthy-looking.

**Reasoning:**
- Anthracnose causes dark, sunken, irregular necrotic spots on leaves, often with defined borders — matches well.
- Die-back affects stems/shoots, not isolated leaf spots.
- Powdery Mildew shows white powdery coating — not present.
- Sooty Mould shows black sooty surface covering — not present here.

The discrete dark necrotic lesions with well-defined margins on an otherwise healthy leaf are classic Anthracnose symptoms.
